highlights: Child Protection Policy aligned with Thai Child Protection Act 2003 and UN Convention
Comprehensive Air Pollution Policy based on AQI and PM2.5 levels from US Embassy / aqicn.org
On-site nurse consultation for students experiencing symptoms during poor air quality
safety.policy_summary: Ascot International School maintains comprehensive Child Protection and Air Pollution policies. The Child Protection Policy outlines a welfare system to respond to abuse and ensure a safe environment in compliance with Thai law and international UN legislation. The Air Pollution Policy establishes concrete tiered responses (ranging from monitoring and modifying activities to moving indoors or cancelling outdoor events and shifting online) based on AQI and PM2.5 readings from official sources.
